# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large mixed bag of call recordings. A significant share is **not** real sales conversation — it is internal logistics/ops chatter (vehicle loading, driver coordination, crane/trailer booking, bill-copy/MTC-document handovers, payment-release follow-ups with transporters). These have been excluded from analysis per instructions.

The **genuine sales calls** that remain are mostly short, transactional, rate-driven exchanges with existing dealers/fabricators/traders (e.g., V R Earth Movers, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Thangaraj Metfra, Uniqcore Const, Tirupati Balasubramaniam, German Polymers/T Ravikumar, Vidveda Krishnasamy, ZIAVUDEEN, Yashil Mayurkumar Shah, Sangeetha Traders/Vadivel). There is no single long "discovery-to-close" consultative sale; almost every call is a **rate check, stock check, cutting-size confirmation, or payment-to-release** exchange. Several calls are heavily broker-style negotiations in Tamil-Telugu mix (Tirupati Balasubramaniam series) bargaining ₹500–₹2000/ton differences.

Given this, the knowledge base below is built strictly from what is actually said — no roofing sheets, no assumed retail showroom scripts. Coverage is honest: this is a **thin, repetitive sample dominated by B2B/dealer rate-negotiation and dispatch-release calls**, not a rich multi-stage sales funnel.

## Products & brand ladder

From the genuine sales calls, BSC deals in **long/flat steel products**, sold both as "main material" (mill-produced, branded) and cut/processed material:

- **TMT / Rebar (கம்பி)**: diameters 8mm–32mm; grades FE500, 500D, 550D, E250, E350, BR/BO grades mentioned. "BO" grade explicitly called rare/non-stock ("C-யும் BO-வும் கொஞ்சம் rare தான்"). E350 BR also flagged as rare ("E350 BR-னா ரொம்ப rare தான் sir கிடைக்கிறது").
- **MS Plates / Checkered plates**: thickness 2mm–46mm+, various widths (1250, 1500, 2000, 2500mm) and lengths (standard coil-cut 6300mm; custom cut on request).
- **Channels (ISMC)**: sizes like 100x50, 150x75, 200x75, 300x140/150.
- **Angles, Beams (ISMB/ISHB)**: 250mm beams mentioned; angle/bolt-hanger items explicitly NOT dealt ("angle bolt-லாம் sale-ல பண்ண மாட்டாங்க").
- **Flats**: e.g., 100x10, 50x5, 100x6.
- **HR Coils**: sold as coil-to-coil or cut-to-sheet ("coil to coil-னா கம்மியாகும்... full coil end bit நீங்க எடுத்துக்கிற மாதிரி இருக்கும்").
- **Pipes (square/rectangular/RHS, CHS)**: explicitly **not** a core BSC product — "pipes நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல... நீங்க direct-ஆ source பண்ணுவீங்க."

**Brand ladder** (as stated by reps):
- **"Sale" (SAIL)** and **Vizag (RINL/Visakhapatnam Steel)** — the two primary mill-sources repeatedly quoted as "main material."
- Competitor/benchmark brands mentioned by customers: **Tata Steel**, Salem Steel Plant, JSW.
- Distinction stressed between **main material** vs **rolling/secondary** — reps insist "main தான்" when challenged, and flag when a competitor's quote looks like rolling/secondary stock.
- SAIL vs Vizag **tag/MTC mismatch** is a recurring documentation issue (Uniqcore Const Site Vinoth calls) — customers need the tag to match invoice origin for plant compliance.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- Checker plate: **₹65,000 + GST** (German Polymers/T Ravikumar, Sept).
- MS plate/sheet (V R Earth Movers series): **₹60–61/kg** (Aug), rising to **₹63**, then **₹65.5/kg** by October ("rate increase ஆயிடுச்சு sir... இந்த மாசம் ₹1500 increase ஆயிருக்கு").
- Channel 300x140 vs 300x150: **₹60 vs ₹63/kg**, ~₹3000 difference per piece, weight difference flagged (42 vs 46 kg/metre).
- TMT/conversion material (Tirupati Balasubramaniam Telugu-Tamil calls): rates quoted around **₹65–71/kg** depending on dia (8mm ≈ ₹70–71, 10mm ≈ ₹68–69, 12-25mm ≈ ₹65–67); heavy day-to-day volatility noted ("rate correct-ஏ 71 8mm-ல... அதே rate உண்டி").
